why_it_fails: Extraction of the correct branch is fine (complete, grade A, every run). Two reasons the store is not "accepted and fresh": (1) STALE. last_success 2026-10-19T02:42Z = 17.7 h old at 20:22Z (>12 h). FRESHNESS: storage.py (~L420) counts a store fresh only if an accepted endpoint succeeded <12 h ago. Newest attempt of any kind in the whole DB is 2026-10-19T05:24Z; investigated 2026-10-19T20:22Z. Scheduler (main.py create_app: APScheduler menu-sync 4/day at 00/06/12/18 America/Chicago, only while uvicorn runs) enqueues only live_settings.active_region_id = ad41b2e9 ("Browser GPS", 50 mi around 40.98,-89.05); the last scheduled job ran 05:00Z (00:00 CDT) and the 06:00/12:00 CDT slots never ran (server not up). This store is ~84 mi from the scheduled region centre (87 mi from the Minonk study centre), so the scheduler never refreshes it; its only attempts come from manual region-8f7772ca / targeted jobs (7c60df34 at 02:18Z). (2) WRONG-BRANCH ENDPOINTS ATTACHED. resolve_menu "Resolved 4 targets" = 1 correct + 3 sibling branches. Chain-nav links to /dispensaries/illinois-antioch|marion/... are crawled; adapters.py resolve_menu L262 `if has_menu_contract(observed) and verified` accepts native-provider endpoints with no branch_slug_conflict guard (the generic path at ~L286 has one); and site_discovery._slug_candidates (L218) only recognizes slugs after /locations|location|stores|store/ or ending in "-<2-letter state>", so "/dispensaries/illinois-antioch/" is invisible: I ran branch_slug_conflict(oakbrook_store, antioch_url) = False. inspect_page rates every Consume page identity "name_locality" (brand + the city listed in the nav), so siblings inherit verification. providers/jane.py then rejects them at fetch (distance guard), so no wrong offers are created, but the endpoints sit as partial and the real Antioch/Marion/Carbondale/St Charles stores (24520a60.., 064a9a7e.., d91bd5b8.., a83b7e25..) get no endpoints. Commit 459b386 (2026-10-18 22:31 CDT, service.py L176-182) now supersedes such wrong-location endpoints on the next fetch; the DB rows (last_attempt 02:42Z) predate it. NOTE for the lead: scripts/sample_stores.py returns 0 here because it passes the raw endpoint row without merged resolution_json (identity_confidence), so jane.py rejects the 1.35 mi offset; with the merged endpoint it returns complete (858).
fix_idea: Shared: (a) extend site_discovery._slug_candidates to read "/dispensaries/<slug>/", "<statename>-<city>" and "<statename>-dispensaries/<city>" shapes (strip a leading full state name; treat another state name as a state conflict) so branch_slug_conflict sees chain-nav siblings; (b) apply branch_slug_conflict (unless identity is address-"matched") at adapters.py L262 for native-provider endpoints, as already done for generic; (c) add `(r"^consume\b", "https://consumecannabis.com/dispensaries/")` to locators.CONNECTORS so discovery reads the branch address from the chain page instead of Bing; (d) operations: make the scheduled sync cover every region that holds retained accepted endpoints (or refresh by endpoint age), not just active_region_id; and keep uvicorn up for the 06:00/12:00/18:00 CDT slots.
